clue.text: Splendid setting for politician's defence

indicators.note: a jewel's setting goes round it, so the first word here wraps around the politician

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, written with the digit 1 as the letter I
a Lib is a Liberal politician

explanation.surface: Praise for the fine way a politician's defence was framed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Splendid' gives A1, and in crosswords the digit 1 often stands for the letter I.
explanation.definitionFit: An alibi is a plea in a court case that the accused was somewhere else, so it serves as a defence.

clue.text: Possibly Raphael's principal financial backer

parts.note: arch means chief or principal, as in arch-enemy
an angel is an investor backing a show or venture

explanation.surface: The chief investor in Raphael's paintings.
explanation.walkthrough: Raphael looks like the painter; here he is the angel of the Book of Tobit.
explanation.definitionFit: Raphael is one of the chief angels named in scripture, alongside Michael and Gabriel.

clue.text: Peculiar expression of girl in Castletown, perhaps

indicators.note: the girl's name sits inside the island's abbreviation

parts.note: Castletown is a town on the Isle of Man, abbreviated IOM
Di is a girl's name, short for Diana

explanation.surface: A girl from a Manx town speaks in an odd way.
explanation.definitionFit: A phrase whose sense is particular to a language is a peculiar turn of speech.

clue.text: Heathen elected to bring up daughter in the country

parts.note: a candidate voted in is elected

indicators.note: in a down clue bringing a letter up moves it higher, earlier in the word

parts.note: the field is the open country

explanation.surface: An unbeliever is voted in to raise his daughter out in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'daughter' names the D of FIELD; 'to bring up' moves it up to give FIDEL.
explanation.definitionFit: An unbeliever, someone outside the faith, is a heathen.

clue.text: Bishop appears with jubilation, though behind time

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
acting with jubilation means acting elatedly, in high spirits

explanation.surface: A bishop turns up joyful, though late for the service.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something late, after the proper hour, is doing it tardily, behind time.

clue.text: End up in jail for causing a fire?

definitions.text: End up in jail for causing a fire?

parts.words: End up in jail for causing a fire?
parts.note: landing in jail makes someone a convict; that short phrase, run together without spaces, names a hilltop signal fire

explanation.surface: Will an arsonist be locked up?
explanation.definitionFit: A signal fire lit on a hilltop warned of danger or invasion.

clue.text: 4'2" flagpole — one vital to an enterprise

parts.note: four feet two inches is fifty inches, Roman L then inch
on a golf green the pin is the flagpole marking the hole

explanation.surface: A short flagpole turns out to be the key to the whole project.
explanation.walkthrough: 4'2" is 50 inches: L (Roman fifty) plus INCH.
explanation.definitionFit: The pin holding a wheel on its axle gives the figurative sense of the person or thing everything depends on.

clue.text: One who tries to acquire money at the bar?

definitions.text: One who tries to acquire money at the bar?

parts.words: One who tries to acquire money at the bar?
parts.note: to tap someone is to ask them for money, but a person who draws drinks at a pub bar works the taps

explanation.surface: A cadger working a pub for loans.
explanation.definitionFit: An old word for a barman, who draws beer from the taps.

clue.text: A man overturned it, cutting across most of another's logic

indicators.note: the first man's name with its turned word cuts into the middle of the trimmed second name
most of the word means all but its last letter

parts.note: Dick is another man's name
Alec is a man's name

indicators.note: the word it is turned over, read backwards

explanation.surface: A man knocked it over, slicing through most of a rival's argument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturned' turns it into TI; 'most of' drops the last letter of DICK; 'cutting across' puts the first man inside the second.
explanation.definitionFit: Dialectic is reasoning by question and answer to reach truth, a form of logic.

clue.text: The present solver and most of the rising generation

parts.note: the solver reading the clue is addressed as you

indicators.note: most of the word means all but its last letter

explanation.surface: You, the solver, and nearly all young people.
explanation.definitionFit: Young people collectively are the coming generation.

clue.text: A clan leader develops it if he can

indicators.note: to develop is to grow into a new form, so these letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A Highland head grows into the role if he is able.
explanation.definitionFit: The head of a Scottish clan or tribe is its chief.

clue.text: Boat taking some copra hurriedly up the Kelantan river

indicators.note: only some of the letters of copra hurriedly are taken, a run inside the words

explanation.surface: A boat hastily carries a cargo of dried coconut upriver in Kelantan, Malaysia.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across the join of copra and hurriedly; the closing words just place the boat in Malaysia, where Kelantan is a state.
explanation.definitionFit: A prahu is a fast Malay sailing vessel, a kind of boat.

clue.text: Ready for a fight involving canines

definitions.text: Ready for a fight involving canines

parts.words: Ready for a fight involving canines
parts.note: the canines are teeth, so being fully equipped for battle is pictured as arming right up to the mouth

explanation.surface: Dogs getting set for a scrap.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means heavily equipped with weapons, fully prepared for combat.

clue.text: Ride on horse is a risky undertaking

definitions.meaning: to let one's money ride on a horse is to bet on it
a venture whose result is a matter of chance

explanation.surface: Getting on a horse is a dangerous business.
explanation.definitionFit: Betting on a horse is wagering, and any chancy venture is a wager in the broader sense.

clue.text: One way to support another Cellini, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down clue the lower pieces hold up the piece above them

parts.note: manner is another word for way
I is the Roman numeral one
St is the abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: One road propping up another.
explanation.definitionFit: Benvenuto Cellini, the Florentine goldsmith and sculptor, worked in the sixteenth-century Mannerist style.

clue.text: Fighter, severely reprimanded, moved abroad

parts.note: the MiG is a Russian fighter plane
to rate someone, an old verb, is to scold them hard

explanation.surface: A fighter pilot, after a dressing-down, was posted overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Birds and people who go to live in another country have relocated, moved abroad.

clue.text: Nonconformist is transported within the German borders

indicators.note: the two words go inside the article, which borders them

parts.note: der is German for the
sent means transported, conveyed

explanation.surface: A rebel is shipped across Germany's frontier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'borders' says the article's letters edge the inserted words.
explanation.definitionFit: A Protestant outside the established Church was a dissenter, a nonconformist.

clue.text: Cause bewilderment, rather like a Birmingham suburb?

parts.note: Aston is a district of Birmingham, in the English Midlands
the suffix -ish means somewhat or rather like

explanation.surface: Something baffling, a bit like a certain corner of Birmingham.
explanation.definitionFit: To amaze or stun someone is to bewilder them.

clue.text: A number gather to cross North Dakota — a huge area

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

indicators.note: the gathering word goes across, straddling, the state abbreviation

parts.note: to amass is to gather together
ND is the postal abbreviation for North Dakota

explanation.surface: A crowd assembles to travel over North Dakota, a vast expanse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A number' is just L, the Roman fifty; the state goes inside the verb after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A continent or large island is a great expanse of dry ground.

clue.text: Scholar's extraordinary ruse to gain a rubber

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a scholar, and the possessive gives MA'S

indicators.note: an extraordinary version is out of its usual order

explanation.surface: An academic's odd trick to get hold of an eraser.
explanation.walkthrough: A rubber is British for an eraser in the surface, but here it is a person who rubs.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who gives massages rubs the body for a living.

clue.text: Current investment in public transport? You can count on it

indicators.note: investing is clothing or surrounding, so the current is wrapped by the transport

parts.note: a bus is a piece of public transport
AC is alternating current

explanation.surface: Money now being put into buses and trains will pay off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Current investment' reads as present spending; the solver has to see AC inside A BUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A frame of beads on wires is a counting device, so its user literally counts on it.

clue.text: Be sure, somehow, to let in master's cat

indicators.note: the rearranged letters admit the single letter into their middle
somehow says the letters come in some other order

parts.note: M is an abbreviation for master

explanation.surface: Make certain to admit the owner's pet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'somehow' makes BURESE from Be sure, and M goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A breed of short-haired domestic cat originating in Myanmar.

clue.text: Break the law and cause resentment

definitions.meaning: to commit a crime or transgress

explanation.surface: Commit a crime and stir up bitterness.
explanation.definitionFit: To commit a crime is to transgress, and hurting someone's feelings is the other sense.

clue.text: Material is supplied here for constructing columns

definitions.text: Material is supplied here for constructing columns

parts.words: Material is supplied here for constructing columns
parts.note: the columns are newspaper columns, and the material is information given to reporters at a briefing

explanation.surface: A builder's yard where stuff for pillars is provided.
explanation.definitionFit: A media briefing hands journalists news to write up as articles.

clue.text: Father West's fruit tree

parts.note: papa is a child's word for father
W is the abbreviation for west

explanation.surface: A dad from the West owns an orchard tree.
explanation.definitionFit: The papaw, also spelt pawpaw, is a tropical tree bearing large melon-like fruit.

clue.text: Nimble start to hurdling in South Wales

parts.note: neat can mean deft or nimble

indicators.note: the start of the word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A deft opening to a hurdles race in South Wales.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is short for a place in South Wales: Neath is a town near Swansea.
explanation.definitionFit: A town and river valley in the south of the principality, near Swansea.

clue.text: Employ leverage to obtain an award

definitions.meaning: to force open with a lever, an accepted spelling of prise
something won as a reward in a competition

explanation.surface: Using pressure to land an honour.
explanation.definitionFit: Levering something open is also spelt this way, and a trophy won is the second sense.

clue.text: Coarse but popular member in neat turnout

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: the limb is put inside the reworked letters
a turnout here is a turning-out, a reshuffle of the word neat

parts.note: a leg is a member, a limb

explanation.surface: A rough but well-liked leg in a smart outfit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turnout' makes EANT from neat, which the limb splits; 'but' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Coarse manners or work lack grace and refinement.

clue.text: Turning-point, in conflict, capturing the empty barn

indicators.note: the war takes in and holds the emptied word

parts.note: war is armed conflict

indicators.note: emptying the word the removes its middle letter, keeping its first and last

parts.note: a shed is a farm outbuilding like a barn

explanation.surface: At a decisive moment in a war, troops seize an abandoned barn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'empty' leaves the first and last letters of the; 'in' is a link word between definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A dividing ridge between river basins gives the figurative sense of a decisive moment of change.

clue.text: Number one is absent from one or the other

indicators.note: the letter for one goes missing from the longer word

parts.note: either means one or the other of two
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A number one is missing from one list or the other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' is read as something that numbs: an old anaesthetic.
explanation.definitionFit: Ether was an early anaesthetic, a substance that numbs patients.
